Two separate road accidents reported in Koderma and Khagaria

In Koderma, a speeding Scorpio vehicle collided with a woman and a child, leaving both seriously injured. Three individuals, including the driver, were taken into custody. In Khagaria, a collision between two motorcycles resulted in two people being injured, with one in critical condition.
